reasoning: batch 1: Independent inspection of panel.png confirms a 700x607 panel with a linear main x axis (Relative Pressure, 0–1) and linear y axis (Uptake, 0–140 cm³ g⁻¹). Tick fits agree with the supplied calibration to about 0.48 px in x and 0.57 px in y. The eligible series is the blue open-circle CO2 195K curve; the coral open-circle N2 77K curve and the embedded inset are excluded. The candidate CO2 rows have correct ownership but omit several native plateau rings and supported fragments in the crowded low-pressure rise. I added only centres supported by visible blue ring contours/fragments in the unchanged source. The crowded rise still contains fused ink for which a distinct centre cannot be defended, so coverage is incomplete and the result requires review.
